$comment: Single source of truth for every bitmap in the project. Consumed by scripts/fetch-textures.mjs at asset-fetch time and by src/config/planets.ts at runtime. Resolutions follow the agreed budget: 4K for hero bodies (Earth, Sun, Jupiter, Saturn, skybox), 2K for everything else, 1K/512 for moons that never fill more than a few hundred pixels.

procedural.reason: No clean equirectangular global mosaic is reachable from a free, scriptable source.
procedural.approach: fBm-driven lineae/crack network over a high-albedo ice base. Bond albedo 0.68 and the measured pale yellow-white ice colour are matched to published values.
Two-tone dark cratered terrain vs. bright grooved sulci, generated with domain-warped noise. Albedo 0.43.
Regolith-smoothed crater field on a very dark carbonaceous base. Albedo 0.068. Renders under ~4 px at its closest framing.
